biotools.summary: Retuve is an open-source explainable pipeline designed for the automated analysis of infant hip ultrasound cine sweeps. It performs combined segmentation, Graf-plane calibration, and frame filtering to assess hip quality and measure key orthopedic angles.
biotools.name: Retuve: Explainable Quality Assessment and Measurement Pipeline for Hip Ultrasound
